description: Nucleotide-anchored transfer of the PKA substrate peptide to test substrate-site occlusion in ADCK1
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ---- ligand-anchored transfer of the PKA substrate peptide into the COQ8A frame ----
r1,h1=parse_pdb("struct/1ATP.pdb")
atp={h['atom']:h['xyz'] for h in h1 if h['name']=='ATP'}
res5,het5=parse_pdb("struct/5I35.pdb"); keys5,seq5,ca5=chain_ca(res5,'A')
anp={h['atom']:h['xyz'] for h in het5 if h['name']=='ANP'}
shared=[a for a in atp if a in anp]
print("shared nucleotide atoms used for ligand superposition:",len(shared),sorted(shared))
P=np.array([atp[a] for a in shared]); Q=np.array([anp[a] for a in shared])
R,pc,qc=kabsch(P,Q)
rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum((apply_rt(P,R,pc,qc)-Q)**2,1)))
print("nucleotide-on-nucleotide RMSD = %.2f A (ATP of 1ATP onto AMP-PNP of 5I35)"%rms)
PKI=np.array([v['atoms'][an] for k,v in r1.items() if k[0]=='I' for an in v['atoms'] if not an.startswith('H')])
PKIlab=[(AA3.get(v['name'],'X'),k[1],an) for k,v in r1.items() if k[0]=='I' for an in v['atoms'] if not an.startswith('H')]
PKIt=apply_rt(PKI,R,pc,qc)
# PKA itself as reference: how many PKA atoms contact PKI (sanity)
def heavy(res,ch='A'):
    pts=[];lab=[]
    for k,v in res.items():
        if k[0]!=ch: continue
        for an,xyz in v['atoms'].items():
            if an.startswith('H'): continue
            pts.append(xyz);lab.append((AA3.get(v['name'],'X'),k[1],an))
    return np.array(pts),lab
PE,labE=heavy(r1,'E')
D=np.linalg.norm(PE[:,None,:]-PKI[None,:,:],axis=2)
print("control: PKA chain E vs its own bound PKI peptide, clashes <2.2 A = %d"%int((D<2.2).sum()))

def occl(name,pdb,ch='A',superpose_to_5i35=True):
    res,_=parse_pdb(pdb); keys,seq,ca=chain_ca(res,ch)
    P_,lab=heavy(res,ch)
    if superpose_to_5i35:
        pr,R2,pc2,qc2,tm,rm,nk=tmalign(ca,seq,ca5,seq5); P_=apply_rt(P_,R2,pc2,qc2)
    else: tm=1.0
    D=np.linalg.norm(P_[:,None,:]-PKIt[None,:,:],axis=2)
    cl=int((D<2.2).sum())
    rc=sorted({(lab[i][0],lab[i][1]) for i in np.where(D.min(1)<2.2)[0]},key=lambda x:x[1])
    return name,round(tm,3),cl,rc

print("\n=== Clashes with the PKA substrate peptide (PKI 5-24) placed by nucleotide superposition ===")
out=[]
for nm,f,c,sp in [("COQ8A 5I35 (nucleotide-bound)","struct/5I35.pdb",'A',False),
                  ("COQ8A 4PED (apo)","struct/4PED.pdb",'A',True),
                  ("ADCK1 AlphaFold","struct/AF-ADCK1.pdb",'A',True),
                  ("COQ8A AlphaFold","struct/AF-COQ8A.pdb",'A',True),
                  ("COQ8B AlphaFold","struct/AF-COQ8B.pdb",'A',True),
                  ("ADCK2 AlphaFold","struct/AF-ADCK2.pdb",'A',True),
                  ("UbiB E.coli AlphaFold","struct/AF-UBIBec.pdb",'A',True)]:
    o=occl(nm,f,c,sp); out.append(o)
    print("%-30s TM=%.3f  clashes<2.2A with substrate peptide: %3d"%(o[0],o[1],o[2]))
print("\nADCK1 residues occupying the substrate-peptide site:",[f"{a}{i}" for a,i in out[2][3]])
print("COQ8A 5I35 residues occupying the substrate-peptide site:",[f"{a}{i}" for a,i in out[0][3]])
json.dump([[o[0],o[1],o[2],[f"{a}{i}" for a,i in o[3]]] for o in out],open("substrate_site_occlusion.json","w"),indent=1)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
nm=[o[0] for o in out]; v=[o[2] for o in out]
ax.barh(nm,v,color=['#E45756' if 'ADCK1 A' in n else '#4C78A8' for n in nm])
ax.set_xlabel("Heavy-atom clashes < 2.2 Å with the PKA substrate peptide (PKI 5-24)\nplaced by nucleotide-on-nucleotide superposition (RMSD %.2f Å)"%rms)
ax.set_title("The canonical protein-substrate groove is occupied in all UbiB proteins tested")
ax.invert_yaxis()
for i,x in enumerate(v): ax.text(x+2,i,str(x),va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
